entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an agent.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, I hope you can help. I bought this jersey a little while ago and I... I think I need to send it back. I'm just so confused by the whole process on the website.
I can certainly help you look into that. To start, could I get your name and order number please?
Yes, it's Anya Sharma, order number VF88602. I just... I don't understand what to do.

Thank you, Anya. I see your order for the Aero Race Jersey, delivered about 42 days ago. I'm happy to walk you through this. So I can best assist, what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
Oh, it's not broken or anything. I just think I ordered the wrong size. It feels way too tight when I'm on the bike. Can't you just help me? I was hoping to exchange it for a larger size.
Of course, I can absolutely help you. I understand, getting the perfect fit is crucial. Let me just pull up our return policy for you. One moment.
Okay, thank you for your patience. I've checked our system, and it looks like you're well within the 90-day return window. We can definitely process this for you.
Oh, really? That's such a relief! I was so worried I had missed the deadline. So, what do I do?

It's no problem at all. Since you're looking for an exchange for a different size of the same jersey, I can process that right now. And Anya, I see you're a VIP member with us. As a thank you for your loyalty, I'm going to waive the return shipping fee for you. I've just sent a pre-paid return label to your email address on file.
Wow, that's amazing! Thank you so much, Isaac. You've made this so easy. I really appreciate it.

You're very welcome. Just print that label, attach it to the original packaging, and drop it off at any post office. Once we see the return has been scanned, we'll ship out the new size to you immediately. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. You've been a great help. Thank you again!
It was my pleasure, Anya. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
